# Speed

The timeline reality of the whole loop versus the optimistic "30 min / 2 h / 1 h" target. Where time actually goes, which stages are genuinely compressible, and which are hard floors set by biology and QC. Grounded in 2024–2026 clinical manufacturing benchmarks (BNT122 ~6 wk, mRNA-4157 ~6–8 wk), the 14-day USP <71> sterility floor, and tumor clonal evolution dynamics that make neoantigen targets stale during the manufacturing interval.
